svg.title: ChatGPT Instant vs Instant plus Sixu — same five-project task, same optimum
svg.desc: High-resolution vector recreation based on user-supplied chat screenshots. Instant corrected its invalid B D E proposal within one response. Instant plus Sixu recorded candidate comparisons. Both concluded A D E with cost 10 and value 25. Sixu internal checks executed: zero.
